vaults.name: Synthetic users: the business cards, run 1
vaults.what: Five invented personas get a RiskMandate business card, scan it and say what they make of it (WS-142): personas, journeys, runs, findings, measurements, the card images and phone screenshots, and the tools. Everybody in it is invented; it is not user research. Audited with its read key by a security sub-agent before publication
